exposure: maternal anti-Sjogren's syndrome A (SSA) antibodies titer
cohort: The study included 63 children born between August 1, 2007, and April 30, 2013, in Peking Union Medical College Hospital, whose mothers were diagnosed with SLE.
finding: SLE offspring have high proportions of childhood-onset SLE and allergic diseases, with the probability of allergic diseases positively related to the titers of anti-SSA in SLE mothers.
